name: Greater Lafayette Career Academy
org: Greater Lafayette Career Academy (Tippecanoe County school districts)
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take career classes in areas like healthcare, trades, aviation, software and culinary arts, with employer partners and a Work Based Learning Capstone option.
who_can_apply: Grade 11 and 12 students at Harrison, Jefferson, Lafayette Virtual Academy, McCutcheon, Tippecanoe Online Academy or West Lafayette high schools. Home school and private school students who live in those districts can also apply. Other students may get leftover seats if their superintendent signs an agreement.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the pages read. The academics page says students can earn college credit.
duration: School-year program for grades 11 and 12; schedule not stated
deadline_text: Enrollment form deadlines: Dec 18, 2026 for Harrison, Jefferson and McCutcheon students. Feb 5, 2027 for West Lafayette students. No deadline listed for other schools.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor. Harrison, Jefferson, McCutcheon and West Lafayette students get the enrollment form link from their counselor. Everyone else fills out the online Enrollment Form on the Next Steps page.
notes: Competitive. Seats are ranked on attendance, behavior, credits, GPA and past courses, and GLCA makes the final call. Each program has its own prerequisites on its page. The pages read do not say how long the day is, how transportation works, or what it costs.
